test_title: PYST 21: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line. All are facing towards North. B is seated third from the extreme right end of the line.

Only two people are seated between B and E.

C is sitting second from the right of B.

F is an immediate neighbour of B and C.

A is sitting to the immediate right of D.

How many people are seated between D and F?
solution:
Given: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line. All are facing towards North.

1) B is seated third from the extreme right end of the line.

2) Only two people are seated between B and E.

3) C is sitting second from the right of B.

4) F is an immediate neighbour of B and C.

5) A is sitting to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/520fb41f564bb12510aac7f827391211268621369d105288c8fde3e3459d2a55.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4782f4d04d1a475dc362bd8474889daf3541cdc13ad0ef141bfd2418ae23f1ed.png] 

So, There are **Two** people are sitting between D and F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
